{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, underestimating momentum in uptrends and overreacting in downtrends",
    "Sentiment positive (1.00) aligns with price support levels while negative (0.00) correlates with price resistance",
    "Mean reversion bias: forecasts converge toward historical mean [70.8] as horizon extends, deviating most at 10-20 day lookahead",
    "Price volatility increases with sentiment certainty - high sentiment confidence amplifies forecast dispersion from baseline",
    "Model over-smooths price volatility, underestimating the magnitude of daily price fluctuations especially near key levels",
    "Sentiment intermediate values (0.33-0.67) indicate uncertainty zones where forecasts should show more gradual transition than constant velocity",
    "Price history length matters: 18-day window shows more accurate alignment than 17-day, suggesting rule uses exact 18 observation window"
] }
